blurbs.press-brake: CNC hydraulic, hybrid and electric press brakes, 22 to 1,323 US tons — Dener premium and NovoTech value lines.
blurbs.panel-bender: CNC panel benders that bend all four sides of a panel without tool changes, 47″ to 165″ bend width.
blurbs.v-grooving-machine: CNC V-grooving machines for sharp architectural bends — horizontal to 20 ft, vertical to 1/4″ plate.
blurbs.folder-sheet-metal-brake: Magnetic brakes, box and pan brakes, hand brakes, hydraulic and electric folders, roofing brakes and 3-in-1 machines.
blurbs.horizontal-press-brake: NC hydraulic horizontal presses for bending, straightening and punching, 11 to 165 US tons.
blurbs.press-brake-tooling-punch-and-die: EUROSTAMP punches, dies, holders and adapters for every clamping style, made in Italy.
blurbs.laser-cutting-machine: Fiber laser cutting machines for sheet and plate, 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft beds, 1.5 to 80 kW.
blurbs.tube-laser-cutting-machine: Tube and profile fiber lasers for Ø0.3″ to 25.2″, 20 to 49 ft bars, 1.5 to 40 kW.
blurbs.laser-welding-machine: Handheld laser welders from 0.8 kW, robotic laser welding cells to 20 kW, and laser cladding.
blurbs.shear-cutting: Sheet metal shears, mechanical guillotines and hydraulic plate shears, 16 ga to 1-9/16″.
blurbs.ironworker-machines: Hydraulic ironworkers and punching machines that punch, shear, notch and bend in one machine.
blurbs.corner-notcher: Hydraulic and pneumatic corner notchers for the corners of boxes, cabinets and panels.
blurbs.plate-beveler: Cevisa portable cold bevellers for weld preparation on plate and pipe, 1/8″ to 4-3/4″ thick.
blurbs.band-saw: Manual, semi-automatic and automatic metal-cutting band saws — Bekamak premium and NovoTech value lines.
blurbs.band-saw-blades: WIKUS bimetal M42 and carbide-tipped band saw blades, welded to length for your saw.
blurbs.circular-cold-saws: Circular cold saws from manual to CNC carbide — ISITAN, CSM, Bekamak and NovoTech value line — and abrasive saws.
blurbs.aluminum-and-pvc-upcut-saws: Automatic upcut, double-head, glazing bead and miter saws for aluminum and PVC extrusions.
blurbs.plate-rollers: Hydraulic 4-roll and 3-roll plate rollers, motorized plate rollers and slip rolls, from 22 ga sheet to heavy plate.
blurbs.angle-rolls: Angle rolls, profile benders, ring rollers and tube rollers for angle, flat bar, pipe and profiles.
blurbs.hydraulic-press: Shop and bench presses from 10 tons, H-frame, C-frame and four-column hydraulic presses to 551 US tons, production presses and orbital riveters.
blurbs.bead-rollers: Bead rollers, beading machines and a lock seamer for HVAC duct and sheet metal work.
blurbs.lock-former: Pittsburgh lock formers, roll formers, an electric seam closer and round duct beading and slitting machines for HVAC ductwork.
blurbs.circle-cutters-and-seamers: Circle cutting and flanging machines for tank ends, dished heads and duct fittings.
blurbs.pipe-benders: CNC, NC, all-electric and hydraulic pipe and tube benders, Ø15/32″ to Ø8-5/8″.
blurbs.pipe-notcher: Tube notchers, hole-saw and end-mill notchers and belt tube-end grinders for frames, railings and roll cages.
blurbs.tube-end-forming-machines: Wecotech tube end forming machines from Switzerland — expanding, reducing, beading and flanging.
blurbs.wire-bending-machines: CSM CNC 3D wire benders fed from the coil, Ø5/32″ to Ø9/16″ wire.
blurbs.welding-positioners: Tilting welding positioners for round welds, 220 to 661 lb.
blurbs.corner-welding-machines: Gecam TIG and plasma corner welders for bent boxes, cabinets and enclosures.
blurbs.sheet-metal-plate-deburring-edge-roundin: Gecam wide-belt deburring, edge rounding, deslagging and brush machines, 5-7/8″ to 53-1/8″ wide.
blurbs.corner-grinding-machines: Gecam corner grinders for the weld seams of boxes, cabinets, doors and tube frames.
blurbs.pipe-sanding-polishing-machines: Automatic, orbital and centreless pipe sanders and polishers, Ø3/16″ to Ø15-3/4″.
blurbs.rebar-bender-and-cutter: GMS rebar benders, stirrup benders, rebar cutters and automatic processing lines, made in Turkey.
blurbs.pvc-aluminum-window-machines: Plastmak aluminum and PVC window and door machinery — welding, cleaning, CNC machining, assembly and complete lines.
blurbs.belt-grinder: Metal belt grinders with 2 – 8″ belts, disc sanders, bench grinders, chamfering machines and dust collectors.
blurbs.drill-press: Gear-head, column and variable-speed drill presses, 1/2″ to 2″ in steel, with power feed and tapping.
blurbs.milling-machine: Turret, universal and heavy ISO50 milling machines, drilling-milling machines and keyseaters.
blurbs.cnc-machine-tools: Dener CNC lathes, vertical and double-column machining centres and a surface grinder; value-line CNC lathe, VMCs and boring mills.
blurbs.cnc-plasma-table: CNC plasma tables 2 × 2 ft to 5 × 10 ft and CNC plasma pipe cutters for Ø2 – 11-3/4″ pipe.
blurbs.power-hammer: Pneumatic planishing hammers, electric power hammers, a diamond roller former and air forging hammers.
